full_text_en:
Ningbo Maritime Court Established and Begins Accepting Cases

From Our Staff Reporter: To meet the needs of China's economic development and opening to the outside world, and in accordance with the Decision of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress on the Establishment of Maritime Courts in Coastal Port Cities, the Supreme People's Court decided on December 4, 1992 to establish the Ningbo Maritime Court, which began accepting cases on January 1 of this year.

The Ningbo Maritime Court has jurisdiction over first-instance maritime and maritime-related cases occurring in the ports and waters of Zhejiang Province (including its affiliated islands, ports, and inland waterways leading to the sea). Appeals against its judgments shall be heard by the Zhejiang High People's Court. Cases already accepted by the Shanghai Maritime Court prior to January 1 shall not be transferred to the Ningbo Maritime Court, and appeals in such cases shall continue to be heard by the Shanghai High People's Court.
